cands.name: Cathy Higgins
cands.bio: Republican. Former Atlantis Mayor (the city's first woman mayor, 3 years) and 12 years on the city council; owner of East Coast Protection; director of dance arts at The King's Academy. Won the Aug 18 primary with 67%.
cands.local_ties: Born in West Palm Beach, raised in Lake Worth; she and her husband Tim run two local businesses (Florida Politics).

record.text: Atlantis council member for about 12 years, mayor 2017-2020. Platform: household costs, police and teacher pay, school choice, controlling spending, steering development away from infrastructure strain.

money_notes.text: Raised more than $18,000 as of August 2026 and reported $1,500 in-kind from the Florida House Republican Campaign Committee.

cands.name: Debra Tendrich
cands.bio: Democrat incumbent, first term (since 2024). Founded the nonprofit Eat Better Live Better in 2016; domestic violence survivor who led a 2026 domestic violence package that passed both chambers unanimously. Age 40.
cands.local_ties: Lake Worth Beach (Florida Politics); arrived in Florida in 2012.

record.text: Passed five bills in her first term, including a domestic violence package (unanimous in both chambers) and a Holocaust Remembrance Day measure. Co-prime sponsor of a proposal to use 'Judea and Samaria' in place of 'West Bank' in state materials.

money_notes.text: Raised more than $56,000 and spent about $24,000 as of August 2026.

endorsements.text: Bipartisan local officials including the Palm Beach County School Board chair, State Attorney Alexcia Cox, Public Defender Daniel Eisinger, Tax Collector Anne Gannon, and all five Lantana council members.

cands.gaps: No campaign website found. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.
